dataset: AHN5 classified-ground DTM0.5m, official AHN dataroom-linked WCS
acquisition_period: AHN5 2023–2025, service snapshot2024-12-10; exact local flight day not asserted
attribution: Bron: AHN(www.ahn.nl), AHN5 DTM. Modified by bounded numeric export and original fitted geometry.
reference_image_note: PDOK2024 orthoHR photograph confirms marked-road boundaries; ignored image is research only, not a shipped texture. No pixel data used as game art.
formula: h(lane)-h(0)=a*lane+q*lane². a and q fitted jointly to valid AHN5 heights over lanes−5…+5m. Centreline height remains exactly unchanged. Bank angle=atan(a).
status: Canonical source; compiled native/contact and fresh packaged review pending
local_derivative_limitation: At880.186m, AHN two-metre derivative at lane+5m is approximately19.2deg versus14.5deg for the fitted quadratic. The relative-height fit remains within 4.9 cm over lanes−5…+5. This is a limited quadratic representation, not a claim of exact pointwise banking. Edge derivatives include possible curb/pixel effects.

paved_bank_contact.status: Source implementation complete; actual compiled/exported contact and final-wall coverage await the root-owned pipeline.
paved_bank_contact.old_problem: The generic 8 m native scenery grid and off-road blend did not follow the paved bowl. Numerical reproduction measured up to 3.27 m of missing support at sampled points inside the mapped paved extent.
paved_bank_contact.scope: Contact extension covers Asphalt runoff sections of tracks containing nonzero quadratic bank controls, including their flat entry/exit. An explicit separate Jeddah exception covers its nonzero scalar-bank Asphalt sections. Every other wholly-q0 circuit retains the previous contact and Ground paths.
paved_bank_contact.contact_geometry: Additional contact strips extend from the existing active-road contact edge to the nearest final authored wall nearface, with 0.02 m clearance. The wall normal and thickness are included. Strip width is at most 1.5 m; heights use the same quadratic road surface and its tangent continuation beyond the white lines.
paved_bank_contact.limits: White-line track limits, road centre, active width, longitudinal elevation and all unrelated protection are unchanged. This supplies existing paved scenery rather than extending the valid lap envelope.
paved_bank_contact.checks: Native fixtures test nonlinear heights, derivatives, wall-face clipping, opposite-side exclusion and a wholly planar control track. The real native audit samples 10%, 50%, 90% and 99% of the full wall-bounded apron on each selected section.
